question_texts: How would you design test cases for a new feature? What elements do you include in each test case? | Explain the difference between smoke, sanity, regression, integration, and system testing, and when you would use each. | Describe the lifecycle of a bug from discovery to closure. How do you prioritize and report bugs? | What test management, bug-tracking, or automation tools have you used? Give a specific example of how you used one in a test workflow. | For a simple login form, what positive and negative test cases would you write? How would you handle edge cases and input validation?

How do you decide what to test for a new feature and how would you write test cases to cover the most important scenarios? | Can you walk me through the lifecycle of a bug from discovery to closure and what information you include when you file a bug report? | What is the difference between smoke testing, regression testing and unit testing, and when would you run each? | Tell me about a time you received feedback on your testing or work; how did you respond and what did you change as a result? | What test automation tools or frameworks have you used or studied, and how would you approach adding a small automated test to an existing CI pipeline?

What is the difference between verification and validation, and when do you use each? | How do you write a clear, actionable bug report? What information do you always include? | How would you design test cases for a login form (including normal, edge and negative cases)? | When should tests be automated versus kept manual? How would you decide what to automate first? | Tell me about a time you found a tricky bug or disagreed with a developer about a bug. How did you investigate and communicate the issue?

How would you design test cases for a simple user login page—what inputs, steps, edge cases and expected results would you include? | Can you describe the bug lifecycle and walk me through how you write a clear bug report so a developer can reproduce and fix the issue? | If you find a bug shortly before release and developers consider it low priority, how would you communicate your concerns and help decide whether it should block the release? | What automation tools or frameworks have you used or learned, and how would you decide which tests to automate first for a web application? | Tell me about a time you received critical feedback or missed a bug; how did you respond and what changes did you make to your testing process?

When you receive a new feature to test, how do you decide what to test and what steps do you take to write clear test cases? | When you find a bug, how do you document and report it so developers can reliably reproduce and fix it? | Which test automation or bug-tracking tools have you used, and can you walk me through creating a simple automated test or filing a clear bug ticket? | Tell me about a time you disagreed with a developer about whether an issue was a bug and how you resolved that disagreement. | If you have limited time before a release, how do you prioritize what to test and how do you decide when to use manual testing versus automation?

Describe a full-stack project where you were responsible for both frontend and backend: what architecture and technologies did you choose, how did you handle state management and API design, and how did you deploy and monitor the app? | How would you design and implement a RESTful API for a resource (for example, tasks): outline the endpoints, database schema, authentication approach, error handling, pagination, and versioning considerations. | A web application you maintain is experiencing slow page load times—explain how you would diagnose performance issues across frontend and backend, what tools you would use, and specific optimizations you might apply. | How do you ensure code quality and reliability across the full stack? Describe your testing strategy (unit, integration, E2E), CI/CD pipeline practices, linters, and code review workflows. | Tell me about a production incident that involved both client-side and server-side components: how did you triage and debug it, what fixes did you deploy, and what steps did you take to prevent similar issues in the future?

Describe a time you diagnosed and fixed a production bug that involved both frontend and backend components; how did you identify the root cause and what steps did you take to deploy the fix with minimal user impact? | Given a single-page application backed by a REST API, how would you design the API and database interactions for a "save draft" feature to ensure consistency and reasonable performance, and what trade-offs would you consider? | A critical page is loading slowly; what tools and steps would you use to profile and optimize both the client-side rendering and server response times? | How do you approach implementing authentication and authorization in a web app, including token storage on the client, session revocation, and protecting sensitive endpoints? | Tell me about a time you worked independently on a feature with vague requirements—how did you clarify expectations, decide on design, and communicate progress or changes with stakeholders?

Describe how you would design and implement a new feature end-to-end (database schema, API design, front-end components). What trade-offs would you consider and why? | A production issue causes slow page loads when traffic spikes. How do you investigate whether the problem is front-end, back-end, or database, and what steps do you take to mitigate it quickly? | How do you implement authentication and authorization in a full-stack application? Where do you enforce authorization checks and how do you protect against common security risks? | You need to change a part of the system that has no tests and high coupling. How do you make the change while minimising risk and improving testability? | Tell me about a time you had a technical disagreement with a teammate about an API or UI decision. How did you communicate your concerns and reach a resolution?

How would you structure a React (or your preferred front-end framework) component tree and state management for a medium-complexity form with dynamic fields and validation, and what trade-offs would lead you to use local state, Context, or a global store? | Describe how you would design a REST or GraphQL endpoint to support pagination, filtering, and sorting for a large dataset; how would you model the database and indexes differently for a relational DB vs a document DB? | A subset of users report a sudden increase in page load time and occasional 500s; walk me through the steps and tools you would use to triage and fix this issue across front-end and back-end services. | Tell me about a time you disagreed with a designer or product manager about how a feature should work; how did you approach the conversation and what was the end result? | How do you balance shipping new features with paying down technical debt, and what process do you follow for code reviews and ensuring changes are maintainable in a mid-sized team?

Can you describe a situation where you had to optimize a slow React component and explain the tools and techniques you used to find and fix the bottleneck? | Walk me through how you would design a REST endpoint for a high-throughput, write-heavy feature, including your choices for API shape, database schema and indexing, and how you'd ensure consistency and scalability. | Describe a time you debugged an intermittent production issue that crossed frontend and backend boundaries; how did you locate the root cause and what steps did you take to fix it and prevent it from happening again? | How do you approach writing tests and setting up CI/CD for a feature that touches both frontend and backend, and how do you balance desired test coverage with the need to deliver quickly? | When handed an ambiguous feature with incomplete requirements, how do you break it down, communicate with stakeholders, and make implementation decisions that minimize rework?
